title: A Fantastic E-bike Tour through Barcelona
text: Pau was an AMAZING guide! He was friendly, funny, responsible and extremely informative. We felt safe the whole time due to Barcelona's great bike lanes and Pau as our guide. The e-bikes were the best bikes we have ever had city tour! This tour is an excellent way to see so much more of Barcelona and find places to return to.

title: The Best Bike Tour in Barcelona
text: Pau was an AMAZING guide! He was friendly, responsible, funny  and super informative! A bike tour is the best way to see Barcelona and a great way to discover areas to return to. The e-bikes were The Best we have ever used (& we do a lot of city bike tours) We felt very safe because Barcelona has a great bike lane system and, of course, Pau was a terrific guide making it easy to follow. We did a different tour each day of our four day trio and this was our favorite by far!
